newsitem.title: UK: London shares end mostly higher in cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: London shares end mostly higher in cautious trade.

text.p: UK shares finished mostly higher on Thursday but investors remained wary ahead of key economic indicators in the U.S. Friday and were still unsettled by yesterday's unexpected UK interest rate rise, dealers said.
The FTSE 100 index of blue-chip shares settled 15.2 points higher at 3,979.1, its peak for the day, after earlier slipping to its lowest level for a month.

But traders said activity had been subdued and the mood was cautious ahead of Friday's potentially market-moving jobs data from the U.S. Volume was a moderate 570 million shares and gainers outweighed losers by roughly three-to-two.
